title: 2. Business and Revenue — Offline
description: Historical synthetic transactions; churn rate, MRR loss and revenue at risk await approved definitions or model predictions.

list.name: platform
list.label: Platform
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(platform, '') AS __text, COALESCE(platform, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: country
list.label: Country
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(country, '') AS __text, COALESCE(country, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(acquisition_channel, '') AS __text, COALESCE(acquisition_channel, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: goal
list.label: Goal
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(onboarding_goal, '') AS __text, COALESCE(onboarding_goal, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: flow
list.label: Flow
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(flow, '') AS __text, COALESCE(flow, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: test
list.label: Test
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ab_test, '') AS __text, COALESCE(ab_test, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Users and transaction users
panels.description: Historical synthetic users; not active subscribers or churn.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id)::integer AS "Users", COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id)::integer AS "Users with transactions" FROM offline_users u LEFT JOIN offline_transactions t ON t.user_id=u.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test'

panels.title: Transactions by product
panels.description: Counts from transaction archive; not retention rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.product AS "Product", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Transactions", COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id)::integer AS "Users" FROM offline_users u JOIN offline_transactions t ON t.user_id=u.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Purchases by day
panels.description: Transaction events in selected install cohort, UTC.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day',t.purchased_at) AS "time", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Transactions" FROM offline_users u JOIN offline_transactions t ON t.user_id=u.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' AND $__timeFilter(t.purchased_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Refunds and billing issues by channel
panels.description: Descriptive events only; no causal attribution or model risk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.acquisition_channel AS "Channel", COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id)::integer AS "Users", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.refunded_at IS NOT NULL)::integer AS "Refunded transactions", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.billing_issue_detected_at IS NOT NULL)::integer AS "Billing issue transactions" FROM offline_users u LEFT JOIN offline_transactions t ON t.user_id=u.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
